lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured grid of high-luminance circular spots is visible along the mid-lateral line, with spot density increasing and becoming more irregular in spatial arrangement toward the dorsal ridges and posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical columns of elevated luminance intersect with horizontal rows of spots, creating a discernible checkerboard lattice across the mid-flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, showing a sharp transition from high-intensity highlights on the dorsal edge to deep shadows on the ventral edge, running parallel to the body axis.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits a sparse distribution of small, low-contrast high-luminance blobs, primarily clustered near the anterior base and trailing edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A series of high-contrast, parallel white striations or elongated bands is visible on the dorsal surface of the head, anterior to the first gill slit.
